reason: The array is coated in grit, so brushing it seems like a natural first step toward restoring power for essential services.
expectation: I expect to clear the panels so they can collect more sunlight, though restarting the services may require further steps.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also seems relevant, but the previous chapter says it needs thaw checks before reopening.

effect: The brush restored the solar supply, making the plant restart controls available.
reaction: That was a straightforward and satisfying first step.
reason: The restored supply can now be connected to the restart controls, which seems directly relevant to restoring services.
expectation: I expect the plant to restart or become ready to restart, though other services may still need attention.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs restoring, but I want to establish power first.

effect: The return plant is running again after its automatic checks, and it can replace propellant lost during the shutdown over the coming weeks.
reaction: I was surprised that some stored propellant boiled away, though restarting the plant gives it time to recover.
reason: The drained water line still needs to be restored as part of restarting services; the available combination suggests using drinking water for that.
expectation: I expect the line to be refilled or prepared for use, though I am unsure how its thaw checks are handled.

alternatives.reason: Moving the lettuce back toward the window also seems useful, but restoring the water line feels more urgent.

effect: The line is primed and water reaches the cabin tap again, completing the service restart. Both troughs now need to return to the window.
reaction: It is reassuring to have the tap working again, though the result did not explain the thaw checks.
reason: Moving the lettuce to the window directly advances the new goal; either trough seems reasonable to move first.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to be placed on the window growing shelf, with the potato trough still to follow.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs to go to the shelf, but I have no clear reason to move it first.

effect: The lettuce trough is at the window shelf; the potato trough still needs to be moved.
reaction: The placement was straightforward, as expected.
reason: Moving the potato trough advances the goal and is the only numbered action available.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to join the lettuce at the window and complete the goal, though another step may be needed.

effect: The potato trough joined the lettuce at the window, completing the final goal and the chapter.
reaction: The placement was predictable, but it was reassuring to see both beds back at the window.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the return plant was the most worthwhile moment: its checks and the loss of stored propellant showed what recovery after the storm involved.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs was straightforward but repetitive, with little new information in either placement.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some stored propellant had boiled away during the shutdown and would take weeks to replace.

arbitrary.text: Using drinking water on the drained line made sense as a way to prime it, but the result left me unsure how the previously mentioned thaw checks were handled.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the expedition recovers from the storm and prepares to bring the frozen core home, though this chapter's trough placements were routine.
